verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.stripe.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and opens with instructions aimed at agents. Terminal docs pages are also served as clean markdown (terminal.md returns HTTP 200), and Stripe documents agent-first developer tooling. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the Terminal docs this way, and no evidence of a Terminal-specific section within llms.txt.
